title: Register Created Response DTO
description: Canonical HTTP 201 body for POST /api/v1/auth/register. Every successful registration returns a standard success envelope. The deployed Backend produces the no-session variant for cohort, invite, and ordinary registrations. The verified self-serve session variant coordinates with TraigentBackend #2481 and remains contract-first until that producer is deployed. The two variants are explicit so a response cannot carry only one member of the access/refresh token pair.

user.description: The newly-created user. Unlike identity-bearing status responses, a successful registration never returns null here.

requires_email_verification.description: True when the user must verify email before login. False for an accepted invite or an email-proven self-serve registration.

email_sent.description: Whether this request successfully dispatched a verification email.

invite.description: Optional accepted-invite context on invite registration.

access_token.description: Present only on the verified self-serve auto-login variant.

refresh_token.description: Present only with access_token on the verified self-serve auto-login variant.

csrf_token.description: Present when the response establishes cookie authentication. Accepted on the no-session variant only for compatibility with deployed 5.x producers.

onboarding_completed.description: Current self-serve auto-login responses report false; absent on no-session registration.
